newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE WIN TOSS, OPT TO BAT V S.AFRICA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE WIN TOSS, OPT TO BAT V S.AFRICA.

text.p: Zimbabwe won the toss and chose to bat against South Africa in the triangular tournament day-night limited overs match at Centurion Park on Saturday.
South Africa - Gary Kirsten, Andrew Hudson, Lance Klusener, Daryll Cullinan, Jonty Rhodes, Hansie Cronje (captain), Shaun Pollock, Dave Richardson, Pat Symcox, Craig Matthews, Allan Donald.
Zimbabwe - Grant Flower, Andy Waller, Alistair Campbell, Dave Houghton, Andy Flower, Craig Wishart, Guy Whittall, Paul Strang, Heath Streak, Eddo Brandes, John Rennie.
